# Northwood Game Haven

> Board game café, game & hobby store, trading card shop, retro arcade, craft soda & candy lounge, private event rooms, and overnight gaming suites in downtown Chippewa Falls, Wisconsin (Chippewa Valley / Eau Claire area).

## Essentials
- Address: 115 W Spring St, Chippewa Falls, WI 54729, USA
- Phone: (715) 861-3214
- Email: stash@northwoodgamehaven.com
- Website: https://gamehaven.guru
- Hours: Mon–Thu 5–9pm · Fri 4–10pm · Sat 10am–10pm · Sun 12–8pm
- Mascot: Stash the Otter

## What you can do here
- Open play: ~150 board games on shelves plus a vault of hundreds more; free to play during a visit ([library](https://gamehaven.guru/board-game-library.html))
- Retro & modern video gaming: SNES, N64, GameCube, Sega, Dreamcast, PlayStation, Wii, Wii U, Switch ([video games](https://gamehaven.guru/video-game-equipment.html))
- Trading cards: buy / sell / trade Magic: The Gathering, Pokémon, One Piece, Yu-Gi-Oh! and more
- Events: tournaments, teach-and-play nights, D&D, card game nights ([calendar](https://gamehaven.guru/events.html))
- Retail: games, accessories, candy, and the Valley's largest craft soda selection

## Booking a private room
Reserve online at https://gamehaven.guru/booking.html — pay by card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay; refundable deposit; after-hours entry via smart-lock door code. 4-hour minimum.
- The Holt — flagship tournament/meeting room
- Stash's Den — raised-table room for karaoke, movies, video games; river-deck access
- The Depths — basement D&D dungeon with official Wizards of the Coast table, CRTs, retro consoles

## Overnight stays (VRBO)
Two apartment-style gaming suites, bookable 24/7 with self check-in:
- The Lodge (poker table): https://www.vrbo.com/5183022
- The Adventurer's Rest (D&D themed): https://www.vrbo.com/5183156
